lede: Every Webflow Site plan, what each bandwidth tier costs, and the cheapest plan for your traffic.
calc_label: Bandwidth your site uses each month (GB)
calc_note: The calculator uses Webflow Site plans: Basic with 10 GB, and Premium from 50 GB up to 2.5 TB of monthly bandwidth. 1 TB is counted as 1,000 GB. The free Starter plan has 1 GB but no custom domain. Workspace plans for teams are billed separately.
after_plans: Prices are per site, in US dollars, plus tax. Premium on the card is for 50 GB of bandwidth; more bandwidth raises the price, as in the table. The Team platform plan is $2,500/month with an annual contract. Ecommerce plans start at $29/month billed yearly. Workspace plans for teams (Core $19, Growth $49) and extra seats (Full $39, Limited $15) are billed separately, prices per month billed yearly.

compare.Free plan: Starter: webflow.io domain, 2 static pages, 1 GB bandwidth
compare.Largest public plan: Premium with 2.5 TB: $1,499/month, or $999/month billed yearly

faq: Webflow Basic costs $25/month, or $15/month billed yearly. Premium starts at $39/month, or $25/month billed yearly, for 50 GB of bandwidth, and goes up to $1,499/month ($999/month yearly) for 2.5 TB. Enterprise is custom.
Yes. The Starter plan is free, with a webflow.io domain, 2 static pages, 1 GB of bandwidth and 50 form submissions. A custom domain needs a paid Site plan.
What is the difference between a Site plan and a Workspace plan?
Webflow says Site plans give you the tools to publish and host a site, while Workspace plans add staging and collaboration for teams. Every account gets a free Workspace plan.
Basic is for simple sites without a CMS and includes 10 GB of bandwidth. Premium adds the Webflow CMS, code components and site search, with 50 GB of bandwidth or more.
